svg.title: Lead error curve + ISO 3408-3 – drawing 44-03
svg.text: Lead error curve – T, E, e_p, v_up, v_300p, v_2πp (ISO 3408-3)
Example screw BS-3210 C5, l_u = 700 mm, T = +10 µm: E = 20.5 µm, E − T = 10.5 µm, v_up = 8.1 µm, v_300p = 8.1 µm, v_2πp = 3.7 µm (grade C5)
any 300 mm window: v_300p = 8.1 µm (largest band)
zoom: v_2πp = largest band in 10 mm = 3.7 µm
Accept: |E − T| ≤ e_p and all v ≤ limits
Grade = best of C3 / C5 / C7 met
e(l) actual travel deviation, corrected to 20 °C
mean travel line = least-squares line through e(l) over l_u
E = rise of the mean travel line over l_u (actual mean travel deviation)
T = specified travel compensation (customer, e.g. 0 or − 20 µm per m against heat)
v_up = width of the band parallel to the mean line that holds the whole curve
v_300p = the same in any 300 mm window, v_2πp = in any one revolution
